# La Villa Coliving

> Premium furnished all-inclusive coliving on the French side, 20 min from Geneva Eaux-Vives by Léman Express, door to door.

## Key Facts
- 29 private furnished rooms (16 to 24 m²) across 3 houses (La Villa, Le Loft, Le Lodge)
- Location: Ville-la-Grand, Ambilly, Annemasse (Haute-Savoie, France) — Geneva Eaux-Vives in 7 minutes by Léman Express from Annemasse station — 18 to 24 minutes door to door depending on the house, 30 minutes to the city centre
- Price: all-inclusive from CHF 1,370/month (contractual rent in euros: from €1,470) for the 4 La Villa rooms sharing a shower room between 2 rooms; CHF 1,430/month (€1,530) with a private shower room
- Included: utilities, fibre up to 8 Gb/s, common-area cleaning 3 times a week, pool, sauna, gym, streaming, yoga and events
- Target: Swiss cross-border workers, expats, young professionals working in Geneva
- 12-month lease: free to leave at any time with 1 month's notice
- No application fee, no agency fee; deposit of 2 months' rent excluding charges
- 100+ residents welcomed since October 2021, run directly by the two founders (Jérôme Austin and Fanny Bela), regular events (pizza nights, yoga classes, afterworks)
- 99% occupancy rate over 5 years

## Properties
- La Villa: 10 rooms, Ville-la-Grand — heated outdoor pool · sauna · gym. Annemasse station 14 min on foot · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 22 min door-to-door.
- Le Loft: 7 rooms, Ambilly — heated indoor pool · sauna · gym. Tram 17 stop 8 min on foot, Annemasse station 18 min · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 24 min door-to-door.
- Le Lodge: 12 rooms, Annemasse — pool · sauna · fitness chalet. Annemasse station 10 min on foot · Geneva Eaux-Vives in 18 min door-to-door.

## Where to look for a room on the French side when you work in Geneva

### The areas

Annemasse, Ambilly and Ville-la-Grand: Léman Express and tram 17, Geneva Eaux-Vives in 7 minutes by train from Annemasse station. Saint-Julien-en-Genevois: buses to Plan-les-Ouates and Carouge. Pays de Gex (Ferney-Voltaire, Saint-Genis): airport, UN, CERN.

### Coliving operators on the French side

La Villa Coliving: 3 houses (La Villa in Ville-la-Grand, Le Loft in Ambilly, Le Lodge in Annemasse), 29 furnished rooms of 16 to 24 m², pool, sauna and gym, all inclusive from CHF 1,370 to 1,430 a month. No application fee, your employment contract is the file. Apply in 2 minutes, answer within 48 hours.

### Peer-to-peer flatshare platforms

La Carte des Colocs, Leboncoin, Roomlala (service fees may apply to the tenant depending on the listing): rooms from €700 to €1,000 depending on the town, bills often on top.

### Facebook groups

The public group "Coliving & Colocation à Genève et alentours !" (about 1,600 members, around a hundred listings a month, run by the La Villa Coliving team), and cross-border commuter groups.

### The CAGI housing exchange

For employees of international organisations: the housing exchange of the Geneva Welcome Centre (CAGI) lists offers in Geneva, in the canton of Vaud and in neighbouring France.

### Your file

No Swiss payslip yet? At La Villa Coliving the file comes down to three items: a signed employment contract or job offer, an ID, and a deposit of two months' rent excluding bills; a guarantor is only asked for case by case, when the contract does not cover the rent — we tell you before we reply, never after the visit. Elsewhere, prepare your contract, ID, proof of income and, often, a guarantor.

## Benefits for Cross-Border Workers & Expats
- ≈ CHF 36/m² all-in (37 to 42 m² of living space per flatmate), while Geneva studio listings run around CHF 50/m² excluding charges (source: our 2026 Housing Observatory)
- French tax address (cross-border worker advantages)
- All-inclusive = no hidden fees, no utility deposit
- International community, help with settling in — residents from 15+ nationalities

## How to Apply
- 2-minute form at https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/candidature — reply within 48 h
- Then: a chat to get to know each other, a house visit, and move-in within 72 h of your first contact if a room is available
- No application fee, no agency fee; deposit of 2 months' rent excluding charges, returned within 30 days of move-out if there is no damage, otherwise within 2 months
- Direct WhatsApp contact: https://wa.me/33664315134
- Referral: a resident who refers a successful applicant receives €150 (the applicant simply mentions it in the form)

## Open Data — Cross-Border Housing Observatory
- Annual study: studio listing rents crossed with travel time to Geneva Eaux-Vives, for 17 French communes on the Léman Express corridor
- Key 2026 figure: in Geneva, a newcomer pays about +44% per m² vs a sitting tenant (listings ≈ CHF 50/m² vs CHF 35/m² OCSTAT for existing leases)
- Page: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/observatoire-logement-frontalier-geneve
- CSV data: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/data/observatoire-data-2026.csv
